rules.name: The Great Workshops
rules.description:
- **Workshop Projects:** when mustering your army, give Workshop Projects to up to 3 units (Incursion), 6 units (Strike Force) or 9 units (Onslaught). Each unit can have 1 Workshop Project, and each Workshop Project can be given to up to 3 units. A unit with a Workshop Project gains the SKRYRE keyword.
- STORMFIENDS units can be given WEAPON TEAM Workshop Projects.
- Workshop Projects are not Enhancements.

rules.name: Overstuffed Power Cells
rules.description:
CLANRATS units from your army gain the SKRYRE keyword and the following ability. **Overstuffed Power Cells:**
Warplock carbines equipped by models in this unit have [RAPID FIRE 2] instead of [RAPID FIRE 1].

rules.name: Volatile Genius
rules.description: Each time a friendly SKRYRE unit is selected to shoot, it can suffer D3 mortal wounds. If it does, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

rules.name: Workshop Projects
rules.description:
​

**Scrap-Welded Armour**
*BATTLELINE unit* Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit, improve that model's Save characteristic by 1 against that attack. Subtract 1" from this unit's Move characteristic.
**More-More Barrels!**
*WEAPON TEAM unit* Each time this unit is selected to shoot, you can re-roll any or all dice used to determine the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.
**Warpstone Supercharger**
*WEAPON TEAM unit* Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit. Those weapons have [HAZARDOUS].
**Meltdown Protocol**
*WEAPON TEAM unit* Once per battle, immediately after this unit has shot, it can shoot again. After it has shot for the second time, roll one D6: on a 1-2, this unit is destroyed; on a 3-5, this unit suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 6, nothing happens.
**Voltaic Shield Amplifiers**
*WARPCLAD unit* Improve this unit's invulnerable save by 1, to a maximum of 4+. At the end of any phase in which this unit made one or more invulnerable saving throws, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
**Reinforced-Ramshackle Hull**
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit* Add 1 to this unit's Toughness characteristic and subtract 1" from its Move characteristic.
**Warp-Lightning Capacitors**
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit* After this unit ends a normal, advance or charge move, select one enemy unit within 6" and roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
**Doomrocket**
*Non-EPIC HERO WARLOCK ENGINEER model* This model is equipped with a Doomrocket: Range 48"; Attacks 2D6+7; BS 4+; S 10; AP -2; D 2; [BLAST 1, HAZARDOUS, INDIRECT FIRE, ONE SHOT, WARPSTONE].

rules.name: Flesh-Sculpting
rules.description:
- When mustering your army, give 1 Mutation to each of up to 3 units (Incursion), 6 units (Strike Force) or 9 units (Onslaught). Each must be a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit.
- A unit with a Mutation can also take 1 Ruinous Defect. If it does, it takes a second, different Mutation.
- A unit cannot take a Mutation and the Ruinous Defect that changes the same characteristic. Bloated Mass and Withered Frame are for MONSTER units only. A Defect is taken only to gain a second Mutation.
- Mutations and Ruinous Defects are not Enhancements.

rules.name: Make-Make New Ones!
rules.description:
- Your They Just Keep Coming! Vermin Ability can also target a destroyed non-CHARACTER MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit. For a MONSTER unit, double the Vermin cost; if you use Thirteen for the Horned Rat instead, Sacrifice 26 models.
- The new unit keeps the Mutations and Ruinous Defects of the destroyed unit and takes 1 more Mutation. It can be placed in and emerge from the Under-Empire, even if it is a MONSTER.
- The new unit gains the MUTATED keyword and this ability. **Unstable Mutation:** This unit has Deadly Demise D6. Each time this ability is triggered, after resolving it, gain D3 Vermin.
- When They Just Keep Coming! creates a new CLANRATS unit, that unit can take 1 Mutation (not Bloated Mass) and gains the MOULDER and MUTATED keywords.

rules.name: Fresh Meat-Meat!
rules.description: Each MOULDER CHARACTER model from your army has this ability: at the end of your Command phase, select one friendly MOULDER BEAST, MOULDER MONSTER or CLANRATS unit within 6" of this model, then select one other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 3" of this model. You can Sacrifice up to 3 models from that SKAVEN INFANTRY unit. If the first selected unit is a CLANRATS unit, for each model Sacrificed, return one destroyed Clanrat model to that unit, not exceeding its starting strength. Otherwise, for each model Sacrificed, one model in the first selected unit regains 1 lost wound. Each unit can only be selected as the first unit for this ability once per phase.

rules.name: Pack-Driven
rules.description:
CLANRATS units from your army gain the MOULDER keyword and the following ability. **Pack-Driven:**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if this unit is within 6" of one or more friendly MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER units, add 1 to the hit roll.

rules.name: Feed the Beasts
rules.description: Each time a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY model is destroyed or Sacrificed within 6" of a friendly MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that MOULDER unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: Mutations
rules.description:
​

**Thickened Hide**
Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.
**Chitinous Plates**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1, to a maximum of 3+.
**Too Many Limbs**
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, excluding weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS].
**Overgrown Musculature**
Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.
**Lengthened Legs**
Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit and add 1 to charge rolls made for this unit.
**Predatory Reflexes**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1, to a maximum of 3+.
**Bloated Mass**
*MONSTER unit only* Add 2 to the Wounds characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Ruinous Defects
rules.description:
​

**Soft Flesh**
Subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.
**Exposed Organs**
Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.
**Missing Limbs**
Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, to a minimum of 1, excluding weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS].
**Atrophied Musculature**
Subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.
**Stunted Legs**
Subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in this unit.
**Uncontrollable**
Subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit, to a minimum of 1.
**Withered Frame**
*MONSTER unit only* Subtract 2 from the Wounds characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Secret Schemes
rules.description:
​

**Choose**
After both players have deployed their armies, secretly select 4 different Schemes from the Hidden Ledger and record them.
**Reveal**
At the start of your Command phase, you can reveal one unrevealed Scheme. Once revealed, it remains active until it is completed or until the battle ends. Multiple Schemes can be active at the same time.
**Complete**
Each Scheme can only be completed once. You can complete a maximum of 4 Schemes during the battle. When a Scheme is completed, resolve its Payment immediately.

rules.name: Black Contracts
rules.description: CLANRATS units from your army gain the ESHIN keyword and the following ability. **Paid Informants:** This unit has the Scouts 6" and Stealth abilities.

rules.name: Death From the Shadows
rules.description: Each time an ESHIN model from your army makes an attack that targets an enemy unit selected for one of your revealed Schemes, add 1 to the hit roll.

rules.name: The Hidden Ledger
rules.description:
​

**Kill-Kill the Head**
**Reveal**: Select one enemy CHARACTER model. **Complete**: That model is destroyed by an ESHIN unit. **Payment**: Gain D3+1 Vermin and 1CP.
**Burn-Burn Their Toys**
**Reveal**: Select one enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit. **Complete**: An ESHIN unit causes that unit to become below half-strength or destroys it. **Payment**: Gain D3+1 Vermin. Until the end of the battle, each time an ESHIN model makes an attack that targets an enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.
**Steal-Steal the Secrets**
**Reveal**: Select one objective in No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone. **Complete**: At the end of your turn, you control that objective and one or more ESHIN INFANTRY units are within range of it. **Payment**: Gain D3+1 Vermin. One ESHIN unit within range of that objective can immediately enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Gnawhole.
**Cut-Cut the Supply**
**Reveal**: Select one enemy non-CHARACTER unit. **Complete**: An ESHIN unit causes that enemy unit to lose one or more wounds during your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **Payment**: Gain D3 Vermin. Until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 2" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic, it cannot make advance moves, and it cannot be removed from the battlefield and set up again by an ability.
**Nothing-Nothing Was Here**
**Reveal**: Select one ESHIN unit. **Complete**: That unit ends your turn wholly within your opponent's deployment zone and is not engaged. **Payment**: That unit can immediately enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Gnawhole. Gain D3 Vermin.
**Silence the Witnesses**
**Reveal**: Select one enemy INFANTRY unit. **Complete**: That unit is destroyed by one or more ESHIN units. **Payment**: Gain D3 Vermin. Select one ESHIN INFANTRY unit from your army that made one or more attacks against that enemy unit during the phase in which it was destroyed. That unit can immediately make a normal move of up to 6". Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 6".
**Sabotage-Sabotage!**
**Reveal**: Select one objective in No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone. **Complete**: At the end of your turn, you control that objective, one or more ESHIN INFANTRY units are within range of it, and at least one such unit is not engaged. **Payment**: Gain D3 Vermin. That objective becomes Sabotaged until the start of your next Command phase. While Sabotaged, enemy models within range of it have an Objective Control characteristic of 0, and each time an enemy unit ends a normal, advance, fall-back or charge move within range of it, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Brewing the Plague
rules.description: At the start of your Command phase, you can brew one Plague. Select one Plague from the Plague Catalogue and pay its listed Vermin cost. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Plague is active and modifies the Pestilence auras of friendly PESTILENS units. You cannot brew the same Plague in consecutive battle rounds.

rules.name: Filth-Filth Carriers
rules.description: CLANRATS units from your army gain the PESTILENS keyword and the following ability. **Plague Carrier:** This unit has a 3" Pestilence aura that carries the currently brewed Plague, but this unit does not gain the normal Pestilence ability. The brewed Plague also affects this unit as though it were an enemy unit within range of a friendly Pestilence aura.

rules.name: Infection
rules.description: Each time an enemy unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks made by a friendly PESTILENS unit, after the attacking unit has finished making those attacks, if that enemy unit lost one or more wounds, roll one D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and becomes INFECTED until the start of your next Command phase. While a unit is INFECTED, the brewed Plague affects it as though it were within range of a friendly Pestilence aura. Each enemy unit can only be rolled for once per phase.

rules.name: The Plague Catalogue
rules.description:
*Brew one Plague at the start of your Command phase by paying its Vermin cost. "Pestilence range" means within range of a friendly Pestilence aura.* **The Weeping Pox (2 Vermin)**
*Lesser Contagion* While an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1, and battle-shock rolls taken for that unit cannot be re-rolled.
**The Red Death (3 Vermin)**
*Virulent Brew* Each time a model in a PESTILENS unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit within Pestilence range, an unmodified wound roll of 5+ scores a critical wound.
**The Crawling Ague (3 Vermin)**
*Virulent Brew* Enemy units within Pestilence range subtract 2" from their Move characteristic, subtract 2 from advance rolls and subtract 2 from charge rolls. Multiple instances do not stack.
**The Black Rot (4 Vermin)**
*Grand Plague* Each time an enemy unit ends a normal, advance, fall-back or charge move while within Pestilence range, roll one D6. On a 4+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. A unit can only suffer these mortal wounds once per phase.
**The Withering Sickness (4 Vermin)**
*Grand Plague* While an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of its melee weapons. If that enemy unit is below half-strength, also worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1.
**Nurglitch's Gift (7 Vermin)**
*Master's Concoction* When this Plague is brewed, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within Pestilence range. On a 2+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, subtract 1 from its Toughness characteristic, it cannot regain lost wounds, and destroyed models cannot be returned to that unit.

rules.name: Yes-Yes, Warlord!
rules.description:
- Each friendly VERMINUS CHARACTER can issue 1 Warlord Command per battle round. EPIC HERO models and a Clawlord on a Gnaw-beast can issue 2 instead, to different units.
- Issue a Warlord Command at the start of any phase, to one friendly CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit within 8" of that CHARACTER that is not battle-shocked.
- That Warlord Command lasts until the end of the turn. A unit can only be affected by one Warlord Command at a time.

rules.name: Warlord Commands
rules.description:
​

**Kill-Kill Them!**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1. If this unit contains 10 or more models, also re-roll a wound roll of 1.
**Move-Move, Cowards!**
Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 2 to advance rolls made for it.
**Hold-Hold or Die!**
Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit. While this unit contains 10 or more models, it can re-roll battle-shock rolls.
**Stab-Stab from Behind!**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit that is also engaged with another friendly SKAVEN unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
**Shields Up-Up!**
Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit, that model has the benefit of cover. If this unit already has the benefit of cover, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 instead.

rules.name: Ranks Upon Ranks
rules.description: While a friendly CLANRATS unit contains 10 or more models, improve its Leadership characteristic by 1 and add 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks made by models in that unit. While it contains 20 or more models, also add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of its models.

rules.name: No Run-Run! Fight-Fight!
rules.description: Once per battle round, when a friendly VERMINUS unit within 8" of a friendly VERMINUS CHARACTER fails a battle-shock roll, you can Sacrifice D3 models from that unit. If you do, that battle-shock roll is treated as having been passed, and until the end of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks made by models in that unit.

rules.name: The First Breach
rules.description: Units from your army in the Under-Empire can emerge during the first battle round, even if the mission does not allow Strategic Reserves to arrive then. Each must still make its Passage roll and follow the normal rules for emerging.

rules.name: Endless Passages
rules.description: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Passage roll.

rules.name: Surging from Below
rules.description: Each time a unit from your army emerges, until the end of the turn: add 1 to the hit roll for ranged attacks made by models in that unit; melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LANCE]; and that unit counts as having remained stationary.

rules.name: Masters of the Under-Empire
rules.description:
​

**Muster Below:**
When you declare battle formations, any number of SKAVEN units from your army that could be placed into Strategic Reserves can be placed into the Under-Empire, ignoring the normal limits on the number of units and points that can start the battle in Strategic Reserves. **No Reserve Deadline:**
Units in the Under-Empire are not destroyed for failing to arrive by the end of the third battle round. They can remain below until the battle ends.

rules.name: Daemonic Conduits
rules.description:
Each time a friendly SKAVEN non-DAEMON PSYKER uses a spell, before making the psychic roll, it can select one visible friendly SKAVEN DAEMON unit within 13" as its conduit. If it does:

- Measure that spell's range and visibility from either the PSYKER or the conduit.
- If that psychic roll has an unmodified 1, the PSYKER's unit does not become battle-shocked, does not resolve Cornered Rats and does not suffer mortal wounds. Instead, the conduit suffers D3 mortal wounds, or D6 mortal wounds if the spell was Overcast.

Each SKAVEN DAEMON unit can be selected as a conduit once per turn.

rules.name: The Thirteenth Toll
rules.description: Each time a spell used through a Daemonic Conduit is Overcast, gain D3+1 Vermin, then each enemy unit within 13" of the conduit must take a battle-shock roll. Each enemy unit that fails that roll suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Plunder and Profit
rules.description:
- **Pirate's Hoard:** while your army includes this Detachment, your Vermin pool can contain up to 20 Vermin instead of 13.
- **Spoils of Battle:** each time a SKURVY unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, gain 2 Vermin, in addition to Feed the Swarm.
- **Plundering Objectives:** in your Movement phase, just after a SKURVY unit from your army ends a normal move, if it is not battle-shocked, it can Plunder one objective within range that your army has not Plundered this turn. If it does, gain 3 Vermin, and that unit cannot declare a charge this turn.
- **Spending Plunder:** at the end of your Command phase, each SKURVY unit from your army that is on the battlefield and is not battle-shocked can buy one option from the Plunder Ledger by spending its cost in Vermin. It lasts until the start of your next Command phase, and a unit can have at most two different options active. Plunder Ledger purchases are not Vermin Abilities: no RATTLETRAP surcharge applies, and Thirteen for the Horned Rat cannot pay for them.

rules.name: Black-Flag Clanrats
rules.description:
CLANRATS units from your army gain the SKURVY keyword and the following ability. **Claim-Claim the Prize!:**
At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is within range of an objective you control, that objective remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

rules.name: Vengeful Crew
rules.description: Each time a friendly SKURVY unit loses one or more models, until the end of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by models in that unit.

rules.name: Black-Flag Mercenaries
rules.description: When mustering your army, you can include units from Index: Black-Flag. Their combined points value cannot exceed half of your army's points limit. Each unit included this way gains the SKURVY keyword.

rules.name: The Plunder Ledger
rules.description:
​

**Stolen Ammo (1 Vermin)**
Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [IGNORES COVER].
**Extra-Extra Dakka! (1 Vermin)**
Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
**Grav-Hooks and Boosters (1 Vermin)**
Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it made an advance move.
**Shiny-Shiny Shields! (2 Vermin)**
Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If they already have an invulnerable save, improve it by 1, to a maximum of 4+.
**Targeting Gubbins (2 Vermin)**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1, to a maximum of 2+.
**Stolen Combat Drugs (2 Vermin)**
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, excluding weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS]. Add 1 to advance and charge rolls made for this unit.
**Warp-Charged Munitions (3 Vermin)**
Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. Those weapons have [WARPSTONE].
**The Really Good Stuff (3 Vermin)**
This unit gains two different 1-Vermin options.
**Aeldari Grav-Drives (4 Vermin)**
Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance or fall-back move.

rules.name: Pride of the Black-Furs
rules.description:
- Friendly STORMVERMIN units have the BATTLELINE keyword, and add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in those units.
- Each time a friendly STORMVERMIN unit is selected to fight, you can Sacrifice 1 model from one friendly CLANRATS or SKAVENSLAVES unit within 6" of it. If you do, that unit is Prideful until the end of the phase. Each time a model in a Prideful unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: The Horned Rat Whispers
rules.description:
- **Prophecy Dice:** at the start of each battle round, roll 3D6 (Incursion), 6D6 (Strike Force) or 9D6 (Onslaught) and set them aside. These are your Prophecy dice for that battle round. At the end of the battle round, discard all unused Prophecy dice.
- **Foretell:** each time a psychic roll is made for a friendly GREY SEER model, or a battle-shock, charge or Passage roll is made for a friendly SKAVEN unit within 13" of one, you can replace one of its dice with an unused Prophecy die after rolling but before resolving it. That Prophecy die is expended, and its value is treated as unmodified. After that roll is resolved, the GREY SEER model's unit (for another unit's roll, the closest friendly GREY SEER model's unit) suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- **Foreseen Glory:** if a Prophecy die showing a 6 replaces a die of a GREY SEER model's psychic roll, and that spell is not being Overcast, also resolve that spell's Overcast effect. This is not Overcasting.
- **Twist-Twist Fate!:** before using a Prophecy die, you can spend 1 Vermin. If you do, increase or decrease that Prophecy die by 1, to a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 6. Each Prophecy die can only be modified in this way once.

rules.name: Drive the Engines Hard
rules.description:
- Add 2 to advance rolls made for friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE units. Friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE units are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they made an advance move.
- **Engine Strain:** at the end of your Shooting phase, each friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE unit that made an advance move this turn and was selected to shoot this phase must take a hazard roll.

rules.name: The Council of Thirteen
rules.description:
- **Seats:** when mustering your army, each friendly SKAVEN CHARACTER with a Clan keyword can hold that Clan's Seat: VERMINUS, SKRYRE, MOULDER, ESHIN, PESTILENS or MASTERCLAN. Each Seat has one holder, and each CHARACTER holds at most one Seat unless a rule says otherwise.
- **Power of the Seat:** while a Seat's holder is on the battlefield, friendly units with that Seat's Clan keyword, and the holder's own unit, have that Seat's benefit.
- **Seize the Seat:** when a Seat's holder is destroyed, that Seat becomes Vacant. At the start of your Command phase, one friendly SKAVEN CHARACTER can claim one Vacant Seat and becomes its holder.
- **Knife in the Dark:** once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, one friendly SKAVEN CHARACTER within 3" of another friendly Seat-holder can betray it. That Seat-holder suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. If it is destroyed, the betrayer becomes the holder of its Seat immediately, even if it already holds a Seat, and you gain D3 Vermin.

rules.name: Council Seats
rules.description:
​

**Verminus Seat**
Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit.
**Skryre Seat**
You can re-roll Warpstone Backlash tests taken for this unit.
**Moulder Seat**
Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
**Eshin Seat**
This unit has the Stealth ability.
**Pestilens Seat**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll.
**Masterclan Seat**
Each time a PSYKER in this unit makes a psychic roll, add 1 to the result.

rules.name: Council Levies
rules.description: When mustering your army, each CLANRATS unit can swear to one Clan whose Seat is held in your army. That unit gains that Clan's keyword, so it has that Seat's benefit while that Seat has a holder.

rules.name: Ambition Unchecked
rules.description: Each time a friendly SKAVEN CHARACTER's unit loses one or more models, until the end of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by models in that unit.

rules.name: Overcharge the Guns
rules.description:
- Friendly WEAPON TEAM units have the BATTLELINE keyword, and add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in those units.
- Each time a friendly WEAPON TEAM unit is selected to shoot, it can suffer D3 mortal wounds. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll for ranged attacks made by models in that unit.

rules.name: Let Them Loose!
rules.description:
- Friendly RAT OGORS and WOLF RATS units have the BATTLELINE keyword, and add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in those units.
- In a turn in which a friendly MOULDER BEAST unit made a charge move, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LANCE].

rules.name: Unseen, Unheard
rules.description:
- Friendly NIGHT RUNNERS units have the BATTLELINE keyword, and add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in those units.
- Friendly ESHIN INFANTRY units have the Stealth ability, and are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made a fall-back move.

rules.name: Frenzied Devotion
rules.description:
- Friendly PLAGUE MONKS units have the BATTLELINE keyword, and add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in those units.
- In a turn in which a friendly PESTILENS INFANTRY unit made a charge move, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LETHAL HITS].

rules.name: There Are Always More
rules.description:
- Melee weapons equipped by models in friendly CLANRATS units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- While a friendly CLANRATS unit contains 20 or more models, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Chief-Chief Engineer
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

Your army can give Workshop Projects to 2 more units, and one unit in your army can have 2 Workshop Projects instead of 1.

rules.name: Spare Rats, Spare Parts
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

In your Command phase, select one friendly SKRYRE VEHICLE, WEAPON TEAM or STORMFIENDS unit within 6" of the bearer. One model in that unit regains D3 lost wounds. Alternatively, select one friendly SKAVEN BATTLELINE unit within 3" of the bearer and Sacrifice D3 models from that unit. If you do, the repaired model regains 3 lost wounds instead.

rules.name: Brass Orb
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit within 12" and roll one D6: on a 1, the bearer suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 2-3, the target suffers D3+3 mortal wounds; on a 4-5, the target suffers D3+6 mortal wounds and is battle-shocked; on a 6, the target suffers 13 mortal wounds and is battle-shocked. The Brass Orb is then expended.

rules.name: Doomsphere
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

After deployment, secretly select one objective in No Man's Land and record it. Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase during battle rounds 3-5, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can detonate it. Units within 3" suffer 2D6+3 mortal wounds; units more than 3" and within 6" suffer D6+3 mortal wounds; units more than 6" and within 13" suffer D3 mortal wounds. Every surviving unit within 6" is then battle-shocked. Until the start of your next Command phase, all models within range of that objective have OC 0.

rules.name: Master-Breeder Supreme
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

Each time They Just Keep Coming! creates a new unit using Make-Make New Ones! while the bearer is on the battlefield, that unit takes 2 more Mutations instead of 1.

rules.name: Needle of the Great Stitcher
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

When the bearer uses Fresh Meat-Meat!: if the target is CLANRATS, each model Sacrificed returns 2 destroyed Clanrat models instead of 1; if the target is a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER, each model Sacrificed restores 2 lost wounds instead of 1. Alternatively, if exactly 3 models are Sacrificed, you can return one destroyed non-CHARACTER model to a MOULDER BEAST unit with D3 wounds remaining. This alternative cannot return a MONSTER model.

rules.name: Prime-Specimen Collector
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle round, when an enemy CHARACTER, BEAST or MONSTER model is destroyed by the bearer's unit, gain D3 Vermin. If the destroyed model was a MONSTER, gain D3+1 Vermin instead.

rules.name: Warpstone Pain-Goad
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle round, at the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to charge rolls made for that unit and it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move. After it completes a charge move, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Master of a Thousand Schemes
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Select one additional Scheme at the start of the battle. Once per battle, when you reveal a Scheme, you can discard it and replace it with one different Scheme you did not originally select; reveal the replacement immediately. This does not increase the maximum number of Schemes you can complete.

rules.name: Master of Escape Routes
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, at the end of any phase, if the bearer's unit is not engaged, it can enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Gnawhole. When that unit next emerges, it does not use that Gnawhole's once-per-turn use.

rules.name: Cloak of Shadows
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer, subtract 1 from the wound roll. Once per battle, when the bearer is selected as the target of one or more attacks, until the end of the phase, enemy models cannot select the bearer as the target of an attack unless they are within 6" of it.

rules.name: Whisper Network
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can reveal one of your Schemes at the start of any phase instead of at the start of your Command phase.

rules.name: Arch-Plaguebrewer
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, when you brew a Plague, the bearer can concoct a Grand Concoction. If it does, brew two different Plagues instead of one and pay both Vermin costs separately. Both remain active until the start of your next Command phase. This does not allow the same Plague to be brewed in consecutive battle rounds.

rules.name: Censer of Thirteen Poxes
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Add 3" to the range of Pestilence aura abilities of the bearer's unit, to a maximum of 8". Each time an enemy unit damaged by attacks made by the bearer's unit is tested for Infection, add 1 to that roll.

rules.name: Tome of Foul Revelations
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle round, the first time an enemy unit within 8" of the bearer becomes INFECTED, gain 1 Vermin. If that unit is a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE, gain D3 Vermin instead.

rules.name: Vial of the Thirteenth Plague
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, at the start of any phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and becomes INFECTED; no Infection roll is required. If it was already INFECTED, it instead suffers D3+2 mortal wounds and remains INFECTED.

rules.name: Great-Great Warlord
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

The bearer can issue 1 more Warlord Command per battle round. Those Commands must be issued to different units.

rules.name: Whip of Domination
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

The bearer can issue Warlord Commands, and use No Run-Run! Fight-Fight! for units, within 13" instead of 8". Each time No Run-Run! Fight-Fight! is used for a unit within 13" of the bearer, Sacrifice 1 model instead of D3.

rules.name: Trophy-Rack of the Conqueror
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit, until the start of your next Command phase, friendly CLANRATS and STORMVERMIN units within 8" of the bearer can re-roll battle-shock rolls and add 1 to charge rolls. If the destroyed enemy unit was a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE, also gain 1 Vermin.

rules.name: Best-Best Killer
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1, to a maximum of 2+. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack against a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a wound roll of 1 and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Map of Thirteen Thousand Tunnels
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not engaged and is wholly within 6" of an unused friendly Gnawhole, you can place that unit into the Under-Empire. That Gnawhole is used.

rules.name: Gnawhole Architect
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, create one friendly Gnawhole wholly within 6" of the bearer and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. It cannot be set up within your opponent's deployment zone.

rules.name: First Claw Above
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

In a turn in which the bearer's unit emerged, add 1 to charge rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Hoarder of Surface Spoils
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

Each time the bearer's unit emerges within range of an objective, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit until your next Command phase. If you gain control of that objective that turn, gain 1 Vermin.

rules.name: Grimoire of Thirteen Names
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO GREY SEER model only.

The bearer knows one spell of your choice from the Lore of the Hidden Fang.

rules.name: Bell-Ringer of the Final Hour
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO GREY SEER model only.

Once per battle round, when the bearer uses a spell through a Daemonic Conduit, it can Overcast that spell even if it has already Overcast this turn. After resolving that spell, the conduit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Thirteen-Eyed Familiar
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO GREY SEER model only.

Once per battle round, after the bearer makes a psychic roll, you can re-roll one of its dice.

rules.name: Captain
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

Once per Command phase, when the bearer's unit or a friendly SKURVY unit within 6" of the bearer purchases a Plunder Ledger option, reduce its Vermin cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.

rules.name: Master-at-Arms
rules.description:
SKURVY CHARACTER model only.

The bearer's unit can also buy this Plunder Ledger option. **Bloody Boarding (3 Vermin):** Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1 and those weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Master Gunner
rules.description:
SKURVY CHARACTER model only.

The bearer's unit can also buy this Plunder Ledger option. **Loaded for Bear (2 Vermin):** Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [LETHAL HITS].

rules.name: Master Helmsman
rules.description:
SKURVY CHARACTER model only.

The bearer's unit can also buy this Plunder Ledger option. **Hit-and-Run Rigging (3 Vermin):** After this unit has shot, if it is not engaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

rules.name: Black-Fur Boarders Upgrade
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - STORMVERMIN unit only; up to three units can have this Enhancement.

This unit gains the SKURVY keyword. Add 1 to charge rolls made for this unit. Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Prize Gunnery Crews Upgrade
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - WEAPON TEAM unit only; up to three units can have this Enhancement.

This unit gains the SKURVY keyword. While this unit has one or more Plunder Ledger options active, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1.
