sharedRules.name: The Vermintide
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is SKAVEN, you have a Vermin pool. At the start of the battle it contains 0 Vermin. Each time you gain Vermin, add it to your Vermin pool. Your Vermin pool can never contain more than 13 Vermin; any Vermin gained beyond that is lost. Vermin stays in the pool until spent. **Gaining Vermin**
**The Swarm Grows:** Start of your Command phase. **Death Breeds Life:**
Just after a friendly SKAVEN unit is destroyed, before resolving other rules triggered by its destruction. **Panic-Panic!:**
Just after a friendly SKAVEN unit fails a battle-shock roll. **They Are Everywhere!:**
Just after a friendly SKAVEN unit emerges from the Under-Empire. **Disturb the Nest:**
Just after a friendly Gnawhole is destroyed. **Waste-Waste Them!:**
The first time in each phase that one or more friendly models are Sacrificed. **Feed the Swarm:**
Just after an enemy unit is destroyed by an attack made by a friendly SKAVEN model. **Take-Take Everything!:**
Just after you gain control of an objective that was not controlled by either player, while one or more friendly SKAVEN units are within range of it. **Paying Vermin**
When a Vermin Ability has a cost of XD3 Vermin: roll that many D3, apply any modifiers, then spend that many Vermin. You cannot choose to pay less than the final cost. **Thirteen for the Horned Rat**
Once per turn, if you cannot pay the full Vermin cost of a Vermin Ability, you can instead Sacrifice exactly 13 eligible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY models (excluding CHARACTER models). If you do, that ability's entire Vermin cost is paid and no Vermin is spent. If you can do neither, that ability cannot be used and no Vermin is spent. **Limits**
Each Vermin Ability can be used once per turn (once in your turn and once in your opponent's turn). Different Vermin Abilities can be used in the same turn. A timing window that passes cannot be saved for later. **Rattletrap Surcharge**
Each time a Vermin Ability targets or selects a RATTLETRAP unit, roll one additional D3 and add the result to its Vermin cost. Thirteen for the Horned Rat pays the entire modified cost. **Vermin Abilities**
**More-More Bodies! (2D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** End of your Command phase. - **TARGET:** One friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit that is below its starting strength. - **EFFECT:** Roll 4D3+1. Return destroyed models to that unit whose combined Wounds characteristics do not exceed the result. You cannot return more than 13 wounds' worth of models, and the unit cannot be returned above its starting strength. **From Below-Below! (1D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** Just after making a Passage roll for a friendly unit, if the result was 2-3. - **TARGET:** That unit. - **EFFECT:** Resolve that Passage roll as a Found It result instead. **Menace Below (2D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** End of your Movement phase. - **EFFECT:** Using Summoned Vermin, add a permanent minimum-sized CLANRATS unit to your army and set it up wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. **Knaw, Knaw, Knaw! (3D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** End of your Movement phase. - **EFFECT:** Set up one friendly Gnawhole more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. It follows all rules for Gnawholes. **They Just Keep Coming! (4D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** Just after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY, MOUNTED or RATTLETRAP unit is destroyed, after resolving Death Breeds Life. - **TARGET:** That destroyed unit. - **EFFECT:** Add an exact copy of the destroyed unit to your army at its starting strength, with all of its wounds remaining and the same wargear and Detachment upgrades, and place it in the Under-Empire. If the destroyed unit was an Attached unit, the copy is of its Bodyguard unit only; CHARACTER models are not added. - **RESTRICTIONS:** This ability cannot target a unit containing only CHARACTER models, a Summoned Vermin unit or a unit created by this ability. If the destroyed unit had used a once-per-battle ability, the copy counts as having used it. **Take Them With Us-Us! (3D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** Just after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit that was engaged with one or more enemy units is destroyed. - **TARGET:** One enemy unit that was engaged with that destroyed unit. - **EFFECT:** Roll one D6 for every 5 models that were in the destroyed unit at the start of the phase (maximum 6D6). For each 4+, the target suffers D3 mortal wounds. **Over Their Corpses! (3D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** Fight phase, just after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit is destroyed. - **TARGET:** One other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 6" of where that unit was destroyed. - **EFFECT:** Your unit can make a surge move of up to 6". During this move it can move within engagement range of enemy models and can end the move engaged. If it has not fought this phase, it is eligible to fight this phase. **They're in the Walls! (1D3 Vermin)**
- **WHEN:** Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a normal, advance or fall-back move within 13" of an unused friendly Gnawhole. - **TARGET:** One friendly unit in the Under-Empire. - **EFFECT:** Roll one D6. 1-3 - Lost-Lost!: That unit is destroyed somewhere in the tunnels; that Gnawhole is not used. When resolving Death Breeds Life for it, gain D6 Vermin instead of D3. 4+ - From the Walls!: That unit emerges wholly within 6" of that Gnawhole and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models, and that Gnawhole is used.

sharedRules.name: The Under-Empire
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is SKAVEN, your army has access to the Under-Empire. Each time a SKAVEN unit from your army is placed into Strategic Reserves, you can place it into the Under-Empire instead. Units in the Under-Empire are Strategic Reserves units and follow all rules for Strategic Reserves, except that they can only arrive on the battlefield by emerging. Units in the Under-Empire are not assigned to a specific Gnawhole. MONSTER, TITANIC and VEHICLE units (excluding RATTLETRAP units) cannot be placed into, enter or emerge from the Under-Empire unless another rule explicitly allows it. A unit emerges when it is set up on the battlefield from the Under-Empire, by Passage or by any other rule. Emerging is a type of ingress move with its own placement, in the same way as Deep Strike: set the unit up as described by Passage or by the rule that let it emerge, ignoring the normal ingress move placement rules (it can be set up within the enemy deployment zone). Each Gnawhole can be used once per turn. A Gnawhole is used when a unit enters the Under-Empire through it or emerges from it. There is no other limit on how many units can enter or emerge each turn. If you have no unused friendly Gnawholes, units in the Under-Empire cannot emerge. At the start of the Deploy Armies step, roll one D3, add 1 to the result and set up that many friendly Gnawholes, each more than 8" horizontally from your opponent's deployment zone. In your Movement phase, just after a friendly SKAVEN unit ends a normal, advance or fall-back move, or is selected to Remain Stationary, if every model in that unit is wholly within 6" of an unused friendly Gnawhole and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model, it can enter the Under-Empire. Remove it from the battlefield and place it in the Under-Empire; that Gnawhole is used. A unit that emerged this turn cannot enter the Under-Empire this turn, and a unit that entered the Under-Empire this turn cannot emerge this turn. In the Move Units step of your Movement phase, when you select a unit in the Under-Empire to make an ingress move, select one unused friendly Gnawhole and make a Passage roll for that unit: - 1 Lost Below: That unit is destroyed. The selected Gnawhole is not used. When resolving Death Breeds Life for that destruction, gain D6 Vermin instead of D3. - 2-3 Wrong Turn: Randomly select one unused friendly Gnawhole (this can be the one you selected). That is the exit. - 4+ Found It: The Gnawhole you selected is the exit. The unit emerges: set it up wholly within 6" of the exit and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. The exit is used. If the unit cannot be set up legally around its exit, set it up around another unused friendly Gnawhole where it can be; that Gnawhole is used instead. If no unused friendly Gnawhole allows a legal setup, that unit is destroyed. When resolving Death Breeds Life for that destruction, gain D6 Vermin instead of D3. At the start of your Command phase in battle rounds 2-5, you can Sacrifice exactly 13 eligible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY models (excluding CHARACTER models). If you do, create D3+1 friendly Gnawholes, each more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. **Gnawhole token profile**
| M | T | SV | W | LD | OC | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | - | 2 | 2++ | 1 | - | 0 | Gnawholes are 30mm tokens. They cannot move or make attacks. Enemy units can select a Gnawhole as the target of attacks as if it were an enemy unit; for every other rule it is not a unit (it is not a destroyed unit for mission purposes and does not block movement). Models can move over a Gnawhole but cannot end a move on top of it. A Gnawhole cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 12" of it. A Gnawhole can be selected as the target of melee attacks while one or more enemy models are within engagement range of it. An enemy unit within engagement range of a Gnawhole is eligible to fight, but can only target Gnawholes with its attacks. Units cannot declare a charge against a Gnawhole. Resolve Disturb the Nest. Units in the Under-Empire are unaffected. The Gnawdrill is not a Gnawhole token. Its datasheet specifies when it functions as a Gnawhole.

sharedRules.name: Scurry Away!
sharedRules.description:
​

**Cornered Rats:**
Each time this unit fails a battle-shock roll, roll one D6. This unit suffers that many mortal wounds. If it is not destroyed, each remaining model can then move up to that many inches. Models can move within engagement range of enemy models; no model can end the move closer to any enemy model than it started; each model must end as far as possible from the closest enemy model; the unit must end in Unit Coherency. **Live to Fight-Flee Another Day:**
When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, instead of selecting a fall-back mode, you can use this ability. Roll one D6. This unit suffers that many mortal wounds. If it is not destroyed, each remaining model can move up to that many inches; models can move within engagement range and each model must end the move no longer engaged with any unit it was engaged with. After the move, this unit becomes battle-shocked (this does not trigger Cornered Rats). Until the end of the turn, this unit is treated as not having made a fall-back move: it can make a normal move, shoot and declare a charge if otherwise eligible.

sharedRules.name: Warpstone
sharedRules.description:
- Each time an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, add 2 to the S characteristic of that attack.
- Each time an attack made with this weapon scores a critical wound, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 2.
- **Critical hits and critical wounds scored with this weapon cause Warpstone Backlash (on a 3+, the attacking unit suffers D3 mortal wounds).**

sharedRules.name: Warpstone Backlash
sharedRules.description: Each time a unit shoots or fights, just after it has resolved its attacks, it must take one Warpstone Backlash test if one or more of its [WARPSTONE] attacks scored a critical hit, and one more Warpstone Backlash test if one or more of its [WARPSTONE] attacks scored a critical wound (at most two tests each time it shoots or fights). For each test, roll one D6: on a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Sacrifice
sharedRules.description: When a rule tells you to Sacrifice a model, select one model from your army on the battlefield that meets every condition of that rule and destroy it. No saving throw or other rule can prevent this. If that model cannot be destroyed, the Sacrifice fails and gives no benefit. Battle-shocked models can be Sacrificed. Models embarked within a TRANSPORT and models in Summoned Vermin units cannot be Sacrificed unless a rule states otherwise. Any other model can be Sacrificed unless the rule says otherwise; it does not have to be a SKAVENSLAVES or CLANRATS model.

sharedRules.name: Summoned Vermin
sharedRules.description:
When a rule tells you to add a unit using Summoned Vermin, add that unit to your army. Its starting strength is the number of models it is created with, and each model has only the default wargear from its datasheet (no Wargear Options or Enhancements). It is not a Reserves unit and cannot be placed into Strategic Reserves or the Under-Empire. Its models cannot be Sacrificed. **Temporary units:**
If the rule removes the unit at a set time, remove it from play at that time. It is not destroyed. **Permanent units:**
Otherwise, the unit remains for the rest of the battle. You cannot gain Vermin from a Summoned Vermin unit being destroyed, being removed or failing a battle-shock roll. They Just Keep Coming! and More-More Bodies! cannot target a Summoned Vermin unit.

sharedRules.name: Verminous Psychic Power
sharedRules.description:
​

**Psyker Level:**
Each PSYKER model has a Psyker Level on its datasheet. Each spell has a Psychic Level. Each battle round, a PSYKER can use spells whose combined Psychic Level does not exceed its Psyker Level; spend a spell's Psychic Level when you use it. At the start of each battle round, reset the Psychic Level each PSYKER has spent to 0. A rule that increases a Psyker Level raises that limit; it does not refund Psychic Level already spent. **Using Spells:**
A PSYKER can use a spell it knows when that spell's WHEN condition is met (for a spell on its datasheet, shown as "(Psychic Level N)", when its text says), if it is on the battlefield (unless a rule says otherwise) and its unit is not battle-shocked. Each PSYKER can use each spell once per phase, unless a rule says otherwise. Select the spell's targets, then make a psychic roll by rolling one D6. The spell resolves whatever the result. If the unmodified result is 1, after the spell resolves, that PSYKER's unit becomes battle-shocked and resolves Cornered Rats, even if it does not have Scurry Away!. This is not a failed battle-shock roll. **Overcasting:**
Once per turn, when a PSYKER uses a spell, before making the psychic roll, you can declare that it will Overcast. If you do, roll 2D6 instead of 1D6, reading each die separately, and resolve the spell's OVERCAST effect as well as its EFFECT. Overcasting does not increase the spell's Psychic Level. If either unmodified die is a 1, after the spell resolves, that PSYKER's unit suffers D6 mortal wounds, becomes battle-shocked and resolves Cornered Rats. Resolve this once per psychic roll, even if both dice are 1s. **Re-rolls:**
A rule that re-rolls a psychic roll re-rolls only the dice it states. No die can be re-rolled more than once. Check for unmodified 1s after all re-rolls. **Psychic Weapons:**
Weapons with [PSYCHIC] (for example Warp bolts, Pox blast and Shadow darts) are not spells. They use the normal attack rules, cost no Psychic Level, make no psychic roll and cannot be Overcast.

sharedRules.name: Lore of Ruin
sharedRules.description:
*Known by: Thanquol and Boneripper, Ikit Claw, Lord Skreech Verminking, Grey Seer, Verminlord Warbringer, Verminlord Warpseer. Warlock Engineers and Arch-Warlocks know Warp Lightning and Howling Warpgale only.* **Warp Lightning (Psychic Level 1, DAMAGE)**
- **WHEN:** Your Shooting phase. - **TARGET:** One enemy unit within 24" of and visible to this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** That unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. - **OVERCAST:** That unit suffers 2D3+3 mortal wounds instead. **Howling Warpgale (Psychic Level 1)**
- **WHEN:** Your Movement phase. - **TARGET:** One enemy unit within 24" of and visible to this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit (4" if it has FLY), and that unit cannot Advance. - **OVERCAST:** Until the start of your next turn, also subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit. **Crack's Call (Psychic Level 2, DAMAGE)**
- **WHEN:** Your Shooting phase. - **TARGET:** One point on the battlefield exactly 18" from and visible to this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** Draw a straight line from this PSYKER to that point. Roll one D6 for each enemy unit (excluding units with FLY) that has one or more models whose base or hull is crossed by that line. On a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (D3+3 if it is a VEHICLE). Each unit can be affected only once each time this spell is used. - **OVERCAST:** The point is exactly 24" away instead, and units are affected on a 2+ instead.

sharedRules.name: Lore of Plague
sharedRules.description:
*Known by: Thanquol and Boneripper, Lord Skrolk, Lord Skreech Verminking, Grey Seer, Plague Priest, Verminlord Corruptor.* **Bless with Filth (Psychic Level 1)**
- **WHEN:** Start of the Fight phase. - **TARGET:** One friendly SKAVEN unit within 18" of this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LETHAL HITS]. - **OVERCAST:** Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ scores a critical hit. **Pestilent Breath (Psychic Level 1, DAMAGE)**
- **WHEN:** Your Shooting phase. - **TARGET:** One enemy unit within 12" of and visible to this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls made for models in that unit. - **OVERCAST:** That unit suffers an additional D3 mortal wounds. **Plague (Psychic Level 2, DAMAGE)**
- **WHEN:** Your Shooting phase. - **TARGET:** One enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** That unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. Then roll one D6 for each other unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of it. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. The plague does not spread further. - **OVERCAST:** Roll for each other unit within 6" instead.

sharedRules.name: Lore of the Hidden Fang
sharedRules.description:
*Known by: Lord Skreech Verminking, Verminlord Deceiver, Eshin Sorcerer.* **Skitterleap (Psychic Level 1)**
- **WHEN:** End of your Movement phase. - **TARGET:** One friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 12" of this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield, more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. That unit counts as having made an ingress move. - **OVERCAST:** Set it up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy models instead. **Warp Stars (Psychic Level 1, DAMAGE)**
- **WHEN:** Your Shooting phase. - **TARGET:** One enemy model within 18" of and visible to this PSYKER. It can be a CHARACTER model in an Attached unit. - **EFFECT:** That model suffers D3 mortal wounds. Allocate them only to that model; excess damage is lost. - **OVERCAST:** That model suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead. **Veil of Shadows (Psychic Level 1)**
- **WHEN:** Your Movement phase. - **TARGET:** One friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 18" of this PSYKER. - **EFFECT:** Until the start of your next turn, that unit cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 12" of it. - **OVERCAST:** 6" instead of 12".

sharedRules.name: Skryre Worship — Test It on Them-Them! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One SKRYRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, and one friendly SKAVEN BATTLELINE unit within 3" of it. **Effect**
Sacrifice D3 models from that BATTLELINE unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for ranged attacks made by models in your SKRYRE unit.

sharedRules.name: Skryre Worship — Throw More Warpstone In! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, when a SKRYRE unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That SKRYRE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit; those weapons also have [HAZARDOUS]. If a weapon already has [HAZARDOUS], subtract 1 from hazard rolls taken for that weapon instead.

sharedRules.name: Skryre Worship — No-No! That Was Supposed to Happen! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a SKRYRE unit from your army fails one or more hazard rolls. **Target**
That SKRYRE unit. **Effect**
Re-roll any or all failed hazard rolls from that sequence. If one or more are still failed after those re-rolls, your unit becomes battle-shocked.

sharedRules.name: Skryre Worship — Emergency Warp-Shield / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a SKRYRE VEHICLE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That SKRYRE VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save. At the end of the phase, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Skryre Worship — Scurry-Scurry! It's Going to Blow! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a SKRYRE INFANTRY unit from your army has shot. **Target**
That SKRYRE INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6+2". It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT, end that move within engagement range, or declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Skryre Worship — Blow It! Blow It Now-Now! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a SKRYRE VEHICLE model from your army is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield. **Target**
That destroyed model. **Effect**
Do not roll for that model's Deadly Demise, Explodes, Catastrophic Warpcore or equivalent destruction ability. That ability automatically triggers. If the damage caused by that ability is determined using one or more dice, you can re-roll those dice.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Flesh Laboratory — Crack the Whip-Whip! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, when a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army is selected to make an advance move; or your Charge phase, when such a unit is selected to charge. **Target**
That unit, if it is within 6" of a friendly MOULDER CHARACTER model. **Effect**
Add 2 to that advance or charge roll and re-roll it. After your unit completes that move, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Flesh Laboratory — Fresh Parts! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Just after another friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 6" of a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army is destroyed. **Target**
That MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, excluding weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS], and one model in your unit regains D3 lost wounds.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Flesh Laboratory — Open the Cages! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Just after a MUTATED unit from your army emerges from the Under-Empire. **Target**
That MUTATED unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls made for your unit and melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LANCE]. If your unit is a MONSTER, it can also re-roll charge rolls this turn.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Flesh Laboratory — Stitch-Stitch! Still Good! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army that is below its starting strength. **Effect**
One model in your unit regains D3+2 lost wounds. If your unit has the MUTATED keyword, it regains D3+3 lost wounds instead.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Flesh Laboratory — Use-Use All the Parts! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
When They Just Keep Coming! creates a new unit using Make-Make New Ones!. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Your unit takes 1 more Mutation.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Flesh Laboratory — Not Dead-Dead Yet! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army is selected as the target of one or more melee attacks. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the MUTATED keyword. On a 4+ (5+ for a MONSTER), do not remove that model. After the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, that destroyed model can fight and is then removed from the battlefield.

sharedRules.name: Shadowy Dealings — Every Rat Has a Price-Price! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One SKAVEN unit from your army. **Effect**
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit gains the ESHIN keyword.

sharedRules.name: Shadowy Dealings — Marked for Death / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **Target**
One ESHIN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit that is the target of a currently revealed Scheme. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your ESHIN unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and a wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit contains a CHARACTER model, those attacks also have [PRECISION].

sharedRules.name: Shadowy Dealings — Scurry Into the Shadows / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an ESHIN INFANTRY unit from your army has finished making attacks. **Target**
That ESHIN INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
If your unit is not engaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6". Alternatively, if it is wholly within 6" of an unused friendly Gnawhole, it can immediately enter the Under-Empire; that Gnawhole is used. A unit that makes the normal move cannot declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Shadowy Dealings — Change-Change the Plan! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One of your unrevealed Schemes. **Effect**
Discard that Scheme and secretly select one different Scheme from the Hidden Ledger that you have not selected. Record it in place of the discarded Scheme. **Restriction**
Once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Shadowy Dealings — Smoke-Smoke Bombs! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an ESHIN INFANTRY unit from your army as the target of one or more ranged attacks. **Target**
That ESHIN INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll, and models in your unit have the benefit of cover.

sharedRules.name: Shadowy Dealings — Poisoned Blades / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase. **Target**
One ESHIN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS]. Against an enemy unit selected for one of your revealed Schemes, those weapons have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] instead.

sharedRules.name: Cauldron of Pestilence — Into the Cauldron! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase, when you brew a Plague. **Target**
One friendly CLANRATS unit within 6" of a PESTILENS CHARACTER model from your army. **Effect**
Sacrifice up to 3 models from your unit. Reduce the Vermin cost of that Plague by 1 for each model Sacrificed, to a minimum of 0. If two Plagues are being brewed, the reduction applies to only one of them.

sharedRules.name: Cauldron of Pestilence — The Plague Takes Hold! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
At the start of the Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **Target**
One INFECTED enemy unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, the target is treated as though it were within range of a friendly Pestilence aura for all purposes, including the normal Pestilence ability.

sharedRules.name: Cauldron of Pestilence — Foam-Froth at the Mouth! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase. **Target**
One PESTILENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for melee attacks made by models in your unit. If the target of those attacks is INFECTED, you can re-roll the wound roll instead.

sharedRules.name: Cauldron of Pestilence — Spread-Spread! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after an enemy unit becomes INFECTED. **Target**
One other enemy unit within 6" of that INFECTED unit. **Effect**
Roll one D6. On a 3+, the target also becomes INFECTED. **Restriction**
An Infection caused by this Stratagem cannot trigger this Stratagem again.

sharedRules.name: Cauldron of Pestilence — Blessed-Blessed Filth! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a PESTILENS unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That PESTILENS unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+. If the target is a CLANRATS unit with Filth-Filth Carriers, this Feel No Pain cannot prevent wounds or mortal wounds caused by the Plague it carries.

sharedRules.name: Cauldron of Pestilence — Leave-Leave the Bodies! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after a PESTILENS INFANTRY unit from your army is destroyed. **Target**
That destroyed unit. **Effect**
Before removing its last model, place one Plague Corpse marker as close as possible to that model. Until the start of your next Command phase, enemy units within 3" of that marker are treated as though they were within Pestilence range for the purposes of the currently brewed Plague. A unit can only be affected by one Plague Corpse marker at a time.

sharedRules.name: Clawpack Horde — Get in Front-Front! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a VERMINUS CHARACTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That VERMINUS CHARACTER unit and one friendly CLANRATS unit within 3" of it. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack would be allocated to a model in your VERMINUS CHARACTER unit, if the selected CLANRATS unit is an eligible target for that attack, allocate that attack to the CLANRATS unit instead.

sharedRules.name: Clawpack Horde — Close-Close the Trap! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase. **Target**
One CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit that is engaged with two or more other friendly SKAVEN units, add 1 to the wound roll and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: Clawpack Horde — Hold-Hold! More Rats Coming! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a CLANRATS unit from your army loses one or more models. **Target**
That CLANRATS unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 6+. In addition, when determining whether your unit contains 10 or 20 models for Ranks Upon Ranks or Warlord Commands, treat it as containing 5 additional models.

sharedRules.name: Clawpack Horde — Push-Push Them Forward! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, when a CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit from your army makes an advance move; or your Charge phase, when such a unit declares a charge. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Sacrifice up to D3 models from your unit. For each model Sacrificed: if making an advance move, add 1" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase; if charging, add 1 to its charge roll. If 3 models were Sacrificed, also re-roll that advance or charge roll.

sharedRules.name: Clawpack Horde — Black-Furs! Kill-Kill! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a charge move engaged with a friendly CLANRATS unit. **Target**
One friendly STORMVERMIN unit that is within 6" of that CLANRATS unit and is not engaged. **Effect**
Your STORMVERMIN unit can immediately declare a charge that targets only that enemy unit. If the charge is successful, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LANCE] until the end of the turn.

sharedRules.name: Clawpack Horde — New Orders! New Orders! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Any phase. **Target**
One CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit from your army that is currently affected by a Warlord Command. **Effect**
Replace that Warlord Command with a different Warlord Command. The new Command lasts for the normal duration.

sharedRules.name: Invasion of the Under-Empire — Back Below-Below! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Fight phase. **Target**
One unit from your army that can enter the Under-Empire, is wholly within 6" of an unused friendly Gnawhole and is not engaged. **Effect**
Place your unit into the Under-Empire. That Gnawhole is used. Your unit cannot emerge during the same battle round.

sharedRules.name: Invasion of the Under-Empire — Flood the Surface! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a unit from your army emerges. **Target**
One other unit from your army in the Under-Empire. **Effect**
Your unit can immediately emerge from the same Gnawhole, making its own Passage roll. This does not count toward that Gnawhole's once-per-turn limit.

sharedRules.name: Invasion of the Under-Empire — Burrowing Crossfire / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One unit from your army that emerged this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [IGNORES COVER].

sharedRules.name: Invasion of the Under-Empire — From Every Tunnel! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Charge phase. **Target**
One unit from your army that emerged this turn. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 2 to charge rolls made for your unit.

sharedRules.name: Invasion of the Under-Empire — Collapse the Passage! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after a friendly Gnawhole is destroyed. **Target**
That Gnawhole. **Effect**
Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of that Gnawhole. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Invasion of the Under-Empire — Armoured Vermin-Tide / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One RATTLETRAP unit from your army that emerged this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Warpstone Backlash still applies.

sharedRules.name: The Dreaded 13th Bell — Ring-Ring the Bell! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just before a friendly SKAVEN PSYKER makes a psychic roll for a spell used through a Daemonic Conduit. **Target**
That SKAVEN PSYKER. **Effect**
Sacrifice one other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY model within 6" of your PSYKER. Your PSYKER can Overcast that spell even if it has already Overcast this turn.

sharedRules.name: The Dreaded 13th Bell — Devour the Backlash / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a Daemonic Conduit from your army would suffer mortal wounds as a result of Daemonic Conduits. **Target**
That Daemonic Conduit. **Effect**
Reduce the number of mortal wounds suffered by D3+1, to a minimum of 0.

sharedRules.name: The Dreaded 13th Bell — Voice of the Horned Rat / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after a spell used through a Daemonic Conduit has been resolved. **Target**
That conduit and the SKAVEN PSYKER that used it. **Effect**
Until your next Command phase, the conduit projects that PSYKER's Aura abilities as though it were that PSYKER. Duplicate instances of the same Aura do not stack.

sharedRules.name: Clan Skurvy — Boarding Party / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Fight phase. **Target**
One SKURVY unit from your army that made a charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LANCE].

sharedRules.name: Clan Skurvy — Cut and Run / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of the Fight phase. **Target**
One SKURVY unit from your army that is engaged. **Effect**
Your unit can make a fall-back move of up to 6".

sharedRules.name: Clan Skurvy — Brace for Return Fire / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets. **Target**
One SKURVY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

sharedRules.name: Clan Skurvy — Point-Blank Volley / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One SKURVY unit from your army, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units, that is engaged and has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit, excluding [BLAST] weapons, have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].

sharedRules.name: Clan Skurvy — Loot the Dead / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of any phase. **Target**
One SKURVY unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase. **Effect**
Gain D3 Vermin.

sharedRules.name: Clan Skurvy — Over the Gunwales! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a SKURVY TRANSPORT unit from your army ends an advance move. **Target**
That SKURVY TRANSPORT unit. **Effect**
One unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can make a Shock Disembark move.

sharedRules.name: Black-Fur Supremacy — Prove-Prove Our Superiority! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **Target**
One STORMVERMIN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a wound roll of 1. If your unit is Prideful, you can re-roll the wound roll instead.

sharedRules.name: Black-Fur Supremacy — Black-Iron Formation! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a STORMVERMIN unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That STORMVERMIN unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 6+. If your unit is Prideful, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+ instead.

sharedRules.name: Black-Fur Supremacy — That Was Our Kill-Kill! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after another friendly SKAVEN unit within 6" of a STORMVERMIN unit from your army is destroyed. **Target**
That STORMVERMIN unit. **Effect**
Your unit is Prideful until the end of the turn. **Restriction**
Once per battle round.

sharedRules.name: Prophets of the Horned Rat — Change-Change the Future! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of the battle round, just after generating your new Prophecy dice. **Target**
Your newly generated Prophecy dice. **Effect**
Re-roll any or all of those dice. You must use the new results.

sharedRules.name: Prophets of the Horned Rat — Read-Read Deeper! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a roll made with two dice (such as an Overcast psychic roll or a charge roll) that is eligible for Foretell, before resolving it. **Target**
The friendly GREY SEER model whose prophecy is being used. **Effect**
When using Foretell for that roll, you can replace both dice instead of one, using two unused Prophecy dice. After resolving that roll, your GREY SEER model's unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead of D3 as a result of using Prophecy dice.

sharedRules.name: Prophets of the Horned Rat — The Future Is Fixed! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a friendly GREY SEER model's prophecy is used with Foretell. **Target**
That GREY SEER model. **Effect**
Select one Prophecy die used for that roll. Do not expend that die; after resolving the roll, return it to your pool of unused Prophecy dice. The GREY SEER model's unit still suffers mortal wounds normally for using it. **Restriction**
Once per battle round.

sharedRules.name: Engines of Ruin — More-More Power to the Engines! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, when a SKAVEN VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to make an advance move. **Target**
That SKAVEN VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Do not make an advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 8" to its Move characteristic. If your unit is selected to shoot this turn, add 1 to its Engine Strain hazard roll this phase.

sharedRules.name: Engines of Ruin — Hold It Steady-Steady! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One SKAVEN VEHICLE unit from your army that made an advance move this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [IGNORES COVER] and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1. After your unit has finished making its attacks, add 1 to its Engine Strain hazard roll this phase.

sharedRules.name: Engines of Ruin — No Brakes! No Brakes! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a SKAVEN VEHICLE unit from your army that made an advance move this turn has finished making its attacks. **Target**
That SKAVEN VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6". It cannot end that move within engagement range. At the end of the phase, your unit automatically fails its Engine Strain hazard roll.

sharedRules.name: Council of Treachery — Better Them-Than Us! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly Seat-holder's unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Select one other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 3" of your unit and Sacrifice up to D3 models from it. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If 3 models were Sacrificed, models in your unit also have Feel No Pain 6+ until the end of the phase.

sharedRules.name: Council of Treachery — The Council Votes! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of your Command phase. **Target**
One Seat that is held. **Effect**
Until the start of your next Command phase, every friendly SKAVEN unit has that Seat's benefit, whatever its Clan.

sharedRules.name: Council of Treachery — A Seat Is Empty-Empty! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a friendly Seat-holder is destroyed. **Target**
One friendly SKAVEN CHARACTER within 6" of it. **Effect**
Your CHARACTER claims that Vacant Seat immediately.

sharedRules.name: Council of Treachery — Not My Fault! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a friendly SKAVEN unit fails a battle-shock roll. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Sacrifice D3 models from one friendly SKAVEN unit with a different Clan keyword within 6" of your unit. Your unit's battle-shock roll is passed instead.

sharedRules.name: Council of Treachery — Fight for Favour! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase. **Target**
Two friendly SKAVEN units with different Clan keywords that are engaged with the same enemy unit and have not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: Council of Treachery — No Witnesses-Witnesses! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after Knife in the Dark destroys a friendly Seat-holder. **Target**
The CHARACTER that betrayed it. **Effect**
Gain 1CP. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in friendly SKAVEN units within 6" of your CHARACTER.

sharedRules.name: Warlock Battery — Fire-Fire Together! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a WEAPON TEAM unit from your army has shot. **Target**
One other WEAPON TEAM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets one of the enemy units hit by the first unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: Warlock Battery — Drag the Guns! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a WEAPON TEAM unit from your army makes an advance move. **Target**
That WEAPON TEAM unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it made an advance move.

sharedRules.name: Warlock Battery — Lean Into It! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One WEAPON TEAM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the hit roll and to the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack's weapon.

sharedRules.name: Beast Pens — Prod-Prod Them! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Charge phase, when a MOULDER BEAST unit from your army declares a charge. **Target**
That MOULDER BEAST unit. **Effect**
Add 2 to that charge roll. After your unit has finished its charge move, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Beast Pens — Gorge on the Fallen / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a MOULDER BEAST unit from your army destroys an enemy unit. **Target**
That MOULDER BEAST unit. **Effect**
One model in your unit regains D3 lost wounds.

sharedRules.name: Beast Pens — Thrashing Death-Throes / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a MOULDER BEAST unit from your army as the target of one or more melee attacks. **Target**
That MOULDER BEAST unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

sharedRules.name: Night Stalkers — Vanish-Vanish! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after an ESHIN INFANTRY unit from your army has shot. **Target**
That ESHIN INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
If your unit is not engaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6". It cannot declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Night Stalkers — Rain of Stars / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One ESHIN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit.

sharedRules.name: Night Stalkers — Strike from Darkness / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **Target**
One ESHIN unit from your army that arrived from Reserves, emerged from the Under-Empire or made a Scout move this battle round, and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the hit roll and the wound roll for attacks made by models in your unit.

sharedRules.name: Plague Congregation — Rabid Zeal / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase. **Target**
One PESTILENS INFANTRY unit from your army that made a charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. After your unit has fought, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Plague Congregation — Wallow in Filth / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a PESTILENS INFANTRY unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That PESTILENS INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+.

sharedRules.name: Plague Congregation — Choking Censers / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of the Fight phase. **Target**
One PESTILENS unit from your army. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within 6" of your unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

sharedRules.name: Endless Swarm — Swarm Them! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
The Fight phase. **Target**
One CLANRATS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit engaged with two or more friendly SKAVEN units, add 1 to the hit roll.

sharedRules.name: Endless Swarm — Too Many to Count / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a CLANRATS unit from your army that contains 20 or more models as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That CLANRATS unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 6+.

sharedRules.name: Endless Swarm — Fill the Gaps! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your Movement phase. **Target**
One CLANRATS unit from your army and one friendly SKAVENSLAVES unit within 6" of it. **Effect**
Sacrifice up to D3 models from that SKAVENSLAVES unit. For each model Sacrificed, return one destroyed Clanrat model to your CLANRATS unit, not exceeding its starting strength.
